- new Entity Component System under the hood, faster but expect some new crashes
- added more logs to the startup to get the details of why some are seeing early crashes with empty logs

- Small fixes

notes.title: Update Notes for January 30, 2025
notes.notes:
- Added Item Dyes, drag and drop an item dye over an item to change the color of that item, including hairstyles.
- Added equipment preview: while dragging and holding an item over an equipment slot, the item is previewed on the player in the world, without needing to slot the item or apply a color dye.

notes.title: Update Notes for November 26, 2024
notes.notes:
New features:
- added player health and energy bars, can be turned off in settings/game
- added robot health bars, can be turned off in settings/game

Bug fixes:
- fixed a crash switching to full screen

notes.title: Update Notes for November 23, 2024
notes.notes:
A few bug fixes:
- it's no longer possible to open the inventory menu from the settings menu
- non-raytracing graphics options will have debug draw line off by default

Note: a new Hero character is included in this build but is not yet playable unless you use dev tools to enable it with F1 then finding "Switch to Hero" button. Keep an eye on that in the new few updates to have a new playable character, though!

notes.title: Update Notes for November 11 2024
notes.notes:
- audio fixes for some of heroine's commentary
- game crashes are now reported to a cloud server for analysis
- settings UI loads the game with the correct values from the settings file
